versions.changelog:
Initial release of open-semantic-scholar skill.

- Opens Semantic Scholar in the Brave browser for academic research and paper discovery.
- Focuses the Brave browser if running and reuses relevant existing tabs when possible.
- Navigates directly to https://www.semanticscholar.org/ and verifies the correct page is loaded.
- Reuses existing authenticated sessions without handling credentials or account creation.
- Does not interact with forms or make changes to account settings.
